answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (supplier, not in the covered scope, which lists only NVDA) reported 47 new machine centers for liquid cooling at its Wuxi plant for NVIDIA AI racks, 100% pre-sold under multi-year awards, with a 2026 target of US$80-90 million of accretive new business. These are company-side claims relayed by finance.yahoo.com; the pre-sold figure and the US$80-90m target are unverified and the target is a forecast, not a result. The Russell Microcap Value removal and the narrative revenue/earnings projections to 2028 (US$485.5m/US$47.9m from NN's narrative; US$489.5m/US$48.3m from unnamed analysts) concern NN itself, not NVIDIA, so they do not match any NVDA question's period or definition and are context only.
